body:
# Rima Mohammad

# Board of Education Member

![](/media/uploads/2026/10/rima-mohammad-cropped-2-scaled.png)

- The Justice Department (DOJ) [](https://restoration-news.com/getContentAsset/661c08d1-24ad-40b1-b06e-ee55198bb1da/347abc5f-3708-4979-a52d-d9fb8570b282/Ann-Arbor-Dhillon-letter-DOJ.jpeg?language=en) Ann Arbor Public Schools to withhold funding if they don’t comply with parental rights laws. The district told the DOJ that it amended its policy, but the Education Department determined their revised language did not result in a substantial change and that the Board’s remarks “confirm the amendments were intended to preserve the prior policy’s effect.”
- Even with the amended policy the board passed, Mohammad voted against it [saying](https://restoration-news.com/getContentAsset/2a77f7b8-940a-482c-b098-de9f70946e30/347abc5f-3708-4979-a52d-d9fb8570b282/Rima-Mohammad-post-about-trans-policy.png?language=en), “My vote was about protecting our students, protecting our district, and making thoughtful policy decisions.”
- Mohammad is aligned with [Rashida Tlaib](https://restoration-news.com/getContentAsset/db075c44-d0ca-4665-804f-fe685833f989/347abc5f-3708-4979-a52d-d9fb8570b282/Rima-Mohammad-aligned-with-Rashida-Tlaib.png?language=en). Tlaib attended a campaign kickoff event for her.
- The school board [](https://restoration-news.com/getContentAsset/66e13547-7ebd-45a5-a0b3-22506040e821/347abc5f-3708-4979-a52d-d9fb8570b282/Ann-Arbor-Affinity-Groups.png?language=en) affinity groups, based on race, ethnicity, and sexuality, to have special speaking privileges at school board meetings. In April 2025, the board voted to eliminate this practice. Mohammad voted against the change.
- Mohammad [](https://restoration-news.com/getContentAsset/65312f9f-4f8b-46b6-b0d6-a91afac4fbd2/347abc5f-3708-4979-a52d-d9fb8570b282/Ann-Arbor-Mohammad-equity-committee.png?language=en) the “equity and inclusion” committee.
